title: knowgov question evidence report
description: What `python harness/questions.py evidence KEY` prints and the MCP tool question_evidence returns (task-0361, decision-0046 point 2): one question's evidence as the instance generated it, the file <evidence>/<subject>/<key percent-encoded><suffix> its questions.toml names, its text verbatim and its sha256; found false with why when the instance generated none or the subject does not know the key. Files only. Version 1; a change is additive or a new version. Exit 2 prints no report.

file.description: the evidence file looked for, relative to the instance

sha256.description: the file's raw sha256, hex; null when not found

text.description: the file's text, verbatim; null when not found

why.description: why nothing was found; null when found
